$comment: The server files the secure build (webpack.secure.js) packages under sitrecServer/.
webpackCopyPatterns.js turns every other file in sitrecServer/ into an ignore pattern,
and scripts/auditBundleEgress.js fails the build if the packaged tree holds a file that
is not listed here, lacks a file marked required, or ships a config.php without the
client certificate authentication seam. Left out on purpose: every endpoint that fetches
from a public data provider on the browser's behalf, the assistant relays, the
diagnostics pages, and the telemetry writers. See docs/dev/Secure-Build.md.
